BMI_Clinical_Note: BMI 18.5–22.9 (Indian normal) — Maintain weight. Anti-cancer diet focus.
Waist_Risk_Indian: Central Obesity (≥80 cm — Indian Women Threshold)
Bone_Density_Concern: HIGH — AI-related bone loss. DEXA annually. Calcium 600–1200 mg/day + Vit D 800–1000 IU/day + weight-bearing exercise.
Nutrition_Impact_Symptoms: Diarrhea; Fatigue; Hot Flashes (Hormone Therapy); Nausea; Neutropenia-related (risk); Weight Gain
Zinc_mg_per_day: 10 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020) — important for immune function + wound healing
Dietary_Fibre_g_per_day: 40 g/day (ICMR-NIN 2020); reduce to 25 g if diarrhoea/mucositis
Omega3_Recommendation: Dietary omega-3: mustard oil cooking + flaxseed + walnuts + fatty fish (if non-veg) 2x/week
Protein_Source_Note: Vegetarian protein: dal+rice combo (complete AA), paneer, curd, soya, moong, rajma, chickpeas, tofu, amaranth
Soy_Food_Guidance: Whole soy foods (tofu/soya/edamame): 1–2 servings/day SAFE for ER+ Indian BC survivors [evidence reassuring]
Alcohol_Guidance: ZERO alcohol — carcinogen; increases BC recurrence risk [ESPEN C5-2]
ICMR_NIN_2020_Reference: ICMR-NIN Nutrient Requirements & RDA for Indians (2020 revision)
Nutrition_Route_ESPEN: Individualized dietary counselling + ONS → EN if goals not met [ESPEN B3-1]
Supplement_Recommendation: ONS 1–2x/day: Pentasure HP / Ensure Plus / Fresubin Energy / Disprolene (Indian brands preferred); Calcium 1000–1200 mg/day (split: 600mg x2; food sources: ragi, dahi, sesame preferred) + Vitamin D 800–1000 IU/day (AI-related bone loss); Vitamin B12 1–2 mcg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020) or 500 mcg/week cyanocobalamin — B12 deficiency common in Indian vegetarians; Algae-based DHA 200–500 mg/day (omega-3 for vegetarian Indian BC patients); Iron 19–29 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020) — monitor Hb; IV iron if <8 g/dL on chemo; Folate 220–400 mcg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020; higher during chemo); Ground flaxseed 1–2 tbsp/day (lignans — phytoestrogen modulation; beneficial ER+ Indian BC survivors); Multivitamin/mineral at RDA dose ONLY (ICMR-NIN 2020). NOT high-dose. Avoid selenium, Vit E, Vit C megadoses during chemo.
Exercise_Plan_ESPEN_India: Aerobic: Brisk walk 45 min/day OR 150–300 min/week (cycling, swimming, Zumba, yoga) [ESPEN B4-1/C5-1]; Resistance: 2–3x/week, 8–12 reps, major muscle groups; can use resistance bands/body weight at home [ESPEN B4-2]; Yoga: 3–5x/week (Suryanamaskar, Pranayama, Shavasana) — evidence for fatigue reduction + cortisol in Indian BC survivors; AI PATIENTS: Weight-bearing exercise ESSENTIAL for bone health (walking/stair climbing 30 min/day minimum); reduces AI-related arthralgia; ELDERLY: Chair-based resistance, balance exercises (Vrikshasana/tree pose), fall prevention; supervised sessions at physiotherapy/yoga centre; TARGET: 150–300 min/week moderate activity — reduces Indian BC recurrence risk and improves overall survival
ESPEN_Guidelines_India: 📋 SCREENING [B1-1]: Regular nutritional assessment from diagnosis. Indian BC patients — ICMR/WHO Asian BMI cut-offs apply (Normal: 18.5–22.9; Overweight: ≥23; Obese: ≥25). [South India (Tamil Nadu/Karnataka/Kerala/Andhra)] | 📋 ASSESSMENT [B1-2]: PG-SGA score elevated → quantitative assessment: 24-hr dietary recall, muscle mass (BIA/DEXA/mid-arm circumference), grip strength, CRP/albumin, NIS. | ⚡ ENERGY [B2-1]: 25–30 kcal/kg/day (ESPEN). Indian context: average Indian BC woman body weight 55–65 kg. Total: 1400–2000 kcal/day depending on stage and activity. | 🥩 PROTEIN [B2-2]: >1 g/kg/day (ESPEN); ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA: 0.83 g/kg/day (healthy); BC treatment: 1.0–1.5 g/kg/day. Vegetarian patients: dal+rice+dairy combination essential for complete amino acid profile. | 💊 MICRONUTRIENTS [B2-4 + ICMR-NIN 2020]: Vitamin D (endemic deficiency in India — 400–1000 IU/day), Calcium (600–1200 mg/day from ragi/dairy/sesame), Iron (19–29 mg/day), Folate (220–400 mcg/day). AVOID high-dose antioxidants during chemo. | 🥗 NUTRITION [B3-1]: Active nutritional counselling + ONS if enriched Indian diet insufficient. | ⚠ INTERVENTION [B3-2]: No energy restriction during treatment. No unproven diets — ketogenic, prolonged fasting, 'cancer-curing' diets widely promoted on Indian social media are NOT evidence-based. | 💊 AROMATASE INHIBITOR: PRIORITY in Indian women: Vit D deficiency endemic + AI worsens bone loss → dual risk. Calcium from ragi/sesame/dairy + Vit D 800–1000 IU/day + weight-bearing exercise. DEXA annually. AI-arthralgia: omega-3 + haldi (turmeric) anti-inflammatory. | 🏋 EXERCISE [B4-1/B4-2]: Aerobic + resistance training recommended. Yoga as adjunct for Indian patients (evidence for fatigue, QoL, cortisol reduction). Lymphedema: progressive resistance IS SAFE. | ❌ BEWARE: High-dose supplement marketing targeting Indian cancer patients (social media/WhatsApp) — vitamin megadoses, 'cancer-curing' supplements, unproven herbal products — not recommended without oncologist approval [ESPEN B2-4].
Diet_Chart_Indian_Meal_Plan: 🌅 Breakfast: Plain dry toast/khakhra (2) + adrak-tulsi tea (cold/room temp, anti-nausea); small bites; avoid strong cooking smells; saunf (fennel) water sips || 🕙 Mid-Morning: Plain khakhra/dry toast + saunf-adrak tea; coconut water sips; room-temp bland foods only; avoid sweet/fatty foods || 🍽 Lunch: 2 whole wheat/multigrain chapati + palak-moong dal (spinach + lentil — iron + folate) + dahi + kachumber salad + 1 glass chaas | Anti-cancer: cruciferous sabzi 3x/week || 🕓 Snack: Banana + moong dal khichdi (plain, no spice) + ORS solution 200ml; AVOID: raw vegetables, high fibre, dairy if intolerant, oily/spicy foods; kairi (raw mango) panna without spice can help electrolytes || 🌙 Dinner: Lentil-spinach soup (1.5 cups) + 2 multigrain roti + 1 boiled egg / paneer + salad | Iron + folate + protein || 🌛 Bedtime: Warm milk + 2 dates (natural melatonin) + 5 walnuts | Sleep + omega-3 || ✅ HOT FLASHES (Tamoxifen/AI): Avoid chai excess, spicy food triggers; cold nimbu pani, chaas (unsweetened) preferred; soya foods (tofu/soy milk) 1–2 servings/day may mildly reduce flashes; flaxseed 1–2 tbsp/day beneficial. || ✅ WEIGHT GAIN (Chemo/Hormone Therapy): Common in Indian BC patients on Tamoxifen/AI. Reduce maida, sugar, fried foods. Increase millets, vegetables, protein. 30 min brisk walk daily minimum. No crash diets during treatment. BMI target 18.5–22.9 post-treatment. || ⚖ WEIGHT NOTE (Indian BMI): Indian women are at higher metabolic risk at BMI ≥23. Obesity (BMI ≥25) significantly increases BC recurrence and mortality in Indian women. Post-treatment: maintain BMI 18.5–22.9 [ICMR/WHO Asian cut-offs]. || Regional: Prefer brown/red rice, ragi, sambhar, rasam (anti-inflammatory spices), coconut in moderation; reduce coconut oil excess; increase fibre from drumstick, raw banana. || 💰 High SES: Access to diverse foods. Avoid over-reliance on supplements vs food. Nutritionist supervision. Include traditional Indian anti-cancer foods alongside international anti-cancer foods. || ⚠ OBESITY (Normal, Indian cut-off ≥25): Obesity significantly increases BC recurrence risk in Indian women. Post-treatment gradual weight loss (0.5 kg/week max). No energy restriction during active treatment. Mediterranean-Indian hybrid diet: dal-sabzi-millet base + minimal ghee/oil. Walk 45 min/day. || 💊 AI PATIENT — CALCIUM FOODS: Ragi (nachni) roti daily, til (sesame) chutney, rajma, dahi, paneer (in moderation), moringa leaves (sahjan), amaranth (rajgira). Sunlight exposure 15–20 min before 10am for Vit D. Annual DEXA scan. || 🌱 VEGETARIAN BC PATIENT: Complete protein strategy — dal+rice/roti at same meal (complementary AA), include rajma/chana/lentils daily, paneer/tofu/soya 1–2x/day, dahi 1–2 cups/day, sprouted legumes. B12 supplement if vegan. Omega-3: flaxseed + walnuts + algae-based DHA supplement. || 👴 ELDERLY INDIAN BC (≥60): Soft textures; 5–6 small meals/day; ragi-based foods for calcium; haldi doodh daily; avoid very spicy/oily foods; sarcopenia screening (grip strength); adequate protein 1.2–1.5 g/kg/day; Vit D 800–1000 IU/day; fall prevention exercises. || ❌ STRICTLY AVOID [ALL INDIAN BC PATIENTS]: Alcohol, tobacco (paan/gutka), vanaspati/dalda (trans fats), excess ghee in obese patients, maida/refined flour products, packaged namkeen/biscuits, sugar-sweetened drinks (even fruit juice), raw/undercooked meat/eggs during chemo. || 🐟 OMEGA-3 FOR VEGETARIANS: Ground flaxseed (1–2 tbsp/day) + walnuts (5–7/day) + mustard oil for cooking + algae-based DHA supplement (250–500 mg/day) — essential since no fish intake. || 🏃 YOGA + EXERCISE [ESPEN B4-1/B4-2]: Brisk walk 45 min/day + yoga (reduces cortisol/fatigue, improves QoL in Indian BC survivors) + resistance 2–3x/week. Reduces BC recurrence risk significantly.
